_comment: W2.15 differential corpus SEED. Each pair pins one field-caught dialect-divergence class: the Tableau formula, the recorded output of the CURRENT vendored translator (sigma_expected + warnings — re-recorded only via diff-check.mjs --record, a reviewed re-baseline), and per-oracle recording SLOTS. Live-oracle recordings (VDS value, ground-truth SQL rows, W2.14 batch-probe readback) are null until a live session records them WITH version keys — never fabricated (red line: version-keyed raw evidence only). SQL statements are authored over the synthetic seed table DEMO_DB.DEMO.SEED_ROWS(NUM_A, NUM_B, TXT_A, TXT_B, DATE_A, FLAG_A) — neutral names only.

pairs.class: ZN(agg) null-guard idiom — the dominant field pattern (PR-508 hotfix: native Zn, no malformed Coalesce)

sql.statement: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(NUM_A), 0) AS V FROM DEMO_DB.DEMO.SEED_ROWS

pairs.class: numeric ZN(a)+ZN(b) must KEEP + (PR-508 hotfix: Coalesce removed from the text-fn census — was silently string-concat &)

sql.statement: SELECT COALESCE(NUM_A, 0) + COALESCE(NUM_B, 0) AS V FROM DEMO_DB.DEMO.SEED_ROWS

pairs.class: string-literal guard chain still converts + to & (the other direction of the text-census hotfix)

sql.statement: SELECT COALESCE(TXT_A, 'none') || TXT_B AS V FROM DEMO_DB.DEMO.SEED_ROWS

pairs.class: DATETRUNC 3rd-arg start-of-week is dropped WITH a verify warning (was silent week-boundary drift)
warnings: ⚠ DATETRUNC start-of-week 'monday' dropped — Sigma DateTrunc has no start-of-week argument; week boundaries follow the warehouse week start. Verify week-grain results.

sql.statement: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', DATE_A) AS V FROM DEMO_DB.DEMO.SEED_ROWS

pairs.class: the start-of-week drop is SCOPED to DateTrunc/DateDiff — CONTAINS keeps 'monday' as a real argument (no-false-trip twin of datetrunc-week-start-drop)

sql.statement: SELECT POSITION('monday' IN TXT_A) > 0 AS V FROM DEMO_DB.DEMO.SEED_ROWS

pairs.class: DATEPART('weekday') -> Weekday() with a numbering-verify warning (was non-existent DayOfWeek)
warnings: ⚠ DATEPART('weekday') → Weekday() — verify numbering: Sigma anchors Sunday=1..7; Tableau follows the datasource start-of-week.

sql.statement: SELECT DAYOFWEEK(DATE_A) AS V FROM DEMO_DB.DEMO.SEED_ROWS

pairs.class: DATENAME('week') -> Text(DatePart("week", ...)) at the source branch (was non-existent Week())

sql.statement: SELECT TO_VARCHAR(WEEKOFYEAR(DATE_A)) AS V FROM DEMO_DB.DEMO.SEED_ROWS

pairs.class: agg/TOTAL(agg) share pattern -> PercentOfTotal(agg, grand_total) — the ONLY translating TOTAL form (standalone TOTAL refuses)
warnings: ℹ Table calc → PercentOfTotal(Sum([Num a]), "grand_total") — CHART/grouped-element context ONLY: place in a grouped workbook element (group by the viz dimensions); window functions silently error in data-model calc columns and workbook master calc columns.

sql.statement: SELECT TXT_A, SUM(NUM_A) / SUM(SUM(NUM_A)) OVER () AS V FROM DEMO_DB.DEMO.SEED_ROWS GROUP BY TXT_A

pairs.class: bounded WINDOW_AVG(agg, -n, 0) -> MovingAvg(agg, n, 0) chart formula (WINPROBE-validated class)
warnings: ℹ Table calc → MovingAvg(Sum([Num a]), 2) — CHART/grouped-element context ONLY: place in a grouped workbook element (group by the viz dimensions); window functions silently error in data-model calc columns and workbook master calc columns.

sql.statement: SELECT DATE_A, AVG(SUM(NUM_A)) OVER (ORDER BY DATE_A ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS V FROM DEMO_DB.DEMO.SEED_ROWS GROUP BY DATE_A

pairs.class: IIF -> If with quoted-literal normalization (single->double quotes)

sql.statement: SELECT CASE WHEN NUM_A > 0 THEN 'pos' ELSE 'neg' END AS V FROM DEMO_DB.DEMO.SEED_ROWS
